Aisha (AE): Hey team - POC customer is getting a 413 when sending chat history + system prompt. payload ~120k chars. They expect full convo preserved. Using model 'rw-standard-8k' via /v1/generate. Any quick mitigations?
Carlos (SE): Can you paste the exact request? headers?
Aisha (AE): here's the simplified curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rw-standard-8k","input":"<very long chat history>"}'
```
Response: 413 Payload Too Large and no body beyond gateway message.
ingest-bot: gateway: client 10.2.3.4 request rejected: request_entity_too_large, length=122334, client_max_body_size=104857
Nina (SRE): Looks like nginx fronting the gateway is hitting client_max_body_size (~100KB). On hosted we do strict limits for safety.
Kai (Dev): For quick POC workarounds: 1) compress payload (gzip) and send Content-Encoding: gzip 2) chunk the history into multiple calls and stitch via server-side session id 3) upload conversation blob to S3 and pass a short pointer/summary to model.
Carlos (SE): Customer wants single-call convenience for evaluation. Can we bump the limit for this specific account?
Nina (SRE): On hosted we can't raise per-account nginx setting without infra change. Options: - create temporary dedicated capacity environment (reserved) where we can relax client_max_body_size - implement streaming chunk-append endpoint (engineering effort) - suggest using the 'context-truncate' helper to keep last N messages + summary of earlier messages.
Aisha (AE): They asked about models with bigger windows. Would switching to a 32k-context variant help?
Kai (Dev): Model with larger context only helps if the gateway accepts the payload. It doesn't change HTTP size. But if they switch to an extended model you still need to send >100KB body; same 413.
Carlos (SE): Practical next steps for the POC: 1) Ask customer to try gzipping request (we support Content-Encoding) 2) Provide sample chunking pattern + reassembly guidance 3) Offer a short-lived dedicated sandbox if they want a single-call test.
Nina (SRE): I'll spin up a repro with a 125KB test payload and confirm exact limit and error chain. Will also check if edge CDN has separate caps.
Aisha (AE): I'll send the gzip sample and chunking snippet to the customer now. If they need the dedicated sandbox, I'll coordinate pricing.
Carlos (SE): Pricing note: dedicated sandbox min commitment usually monthly; for short evals we can offer a two-week trial credit — check with pricing ops.
Kai (Dev): Sample gzip curl to try:
```
echo -n 'LONG_PAYLOAD' | gzip | curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Encoding: gzip' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  --data-binary @-
```
Aisha (AE): Customer tried gzip and got 200! quality checks next. thanks all :tada:
Carlos (SE): Great. Please capture exact payload size and headers so we can add to docs and sales FAQ.
Nina (SRE): Filed infra ticket INF-897 to document limit and add monitoring alert for repeated 413 spikes.
Aisha (AE): noted — sending update to customer. :thumbsup:
